notes.title: Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
[p]Thanks so much to everyone who has supported [i]Pack It Out[/i] in its earliest form. We have a big update for you today addressing some early feedback. 
[/p][p]The new update includes the following gameplay changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added a Ranger Journal – track your findings, lifetime trash collected, and get hints as to what’s still out there![/p][/*][*][p]Chick behavior improvements – you can now bring your trusty canine companion to Lucy Falls![/p][/*][*][p]New wildlife to encounter – foxes and stags now roam the park![/p][/*][*][p]New cryptid to encounter – rumors tell of strange encounters in Lucy Falls at night.[/p][/*][*][p]How to Play – explains controls and interactable objects.[/p][/*][/list][p]We have also updated the store page and trailer to better reflect the game’s new features, so go check it out!
[/p][p]Sincerely, 
A couple of dead bugs.[/p]

tags.feature: Added a Ranger Journal – track your findings, lifetime trash collected, and get hints as to what’s still out there!
Chick behavior improvements – you can now bring your trusty canine companion to Lucy Falls!
New wildlife to encounter – foxes and stags now roam the park!
New cryptid to encounter – rumors tell of strange encounters in Lucy Falls at night.
How to Play – explains controls and interactable objects.
